observer_scope: Progress, actual update-source and batch hashes, finite checks and stage-end checkpoints only. No change to model, loss, update order, schedule, seeds, corpus, or metric.
observer_validation: Reduced natural-corpus seed30999 run with and without observer produced byte-identical curves, summary and core audit. Validation is not scientific evidence.
corpus_validation: All four source-package hashes and all six generated corpus hashes match the frozen manifest.

runtime.backend: CPU float32; deterministic algorithms enabled; no quantization

test_fixture_exclusion: Existing natural_r1_fake summaries are manually constructed adjudicator test fixtures, not executed confirmatory runs. They are excluded from the scientific output directory, evidence and seed-execution accounting.
stopping: Run the ten fixed seeds; no efficacy-based early stop, rescue seeds, threshold changes or corpus changes. Technical failures must be preserved and reported, never counted as efficacy results.
